description: This file defines the ACLJSController class, which handles access control logic for generating JavaScript code that manages user permissions and UI element states based on ACL configurations in the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: ACLJSController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating ACL-based JavaScript snippets, rendering HTML values for ACL restrictions, and providing methods to retrieve scripts for specific fields within the SuiteCRM module framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ACLJSController with module, form, and ownership parameters.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to enforce ACL restrictions on view actions and fields, based on module-specific ACL definitions.

methods.name: getHTMLValues
methods.description: Returns HTML attribute values (like href or className) based on display options defined in ACLs.

methods.name: getFieldByIdScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to disable or modify elements identified by ID based on ACL checks.

methods.name: getFieldByNameScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to modify fields identified by name attribute based on ACL checks.

methods.name: getFieldByFormScript
methods.description: Creates JavaScript to modify fields within a specific form based on ACL rules.
